# Production Runtime Foundation

PI1 adds an optional, local-only HASK runtime under `src/hadocs/knowledge/hask_runtime/`. `BundleDiscovery` resolves an explicit path or deterministic local standard paths. `ContractValidator` validates contract structure, compatibility, HADocs minimum version, checksums and references. `RuntimeCache` stores one immutable content-addressed snapshot in process memory. `KnowledgeProvider` exposes the active snapshot. `BundleManager` owns lifecycle and internal diagnostics.

There is deliberately no import or call from normal scan, scoring, Incident, Finding, report or UI code. Consumers must instantiate the manager explicitly. HASK authoritative YAML and Python modules are never read or imported.
